purpose: Computationally shard the already frozen 24,576-case Model 3 Chapter 2 bridge campaign without changing biological configurations, seeds, endpoints, thresholds, or analysis.
partition_rule: history seed at zero-based index i is assigned to shard i mod 16
case_rng_invariance: Simulation replicate RNG is determined by history_seed and demographic_seed; shard index is never supplied to the biological operator.

artifact_policy.raw_case_arrays: ephemeral within shard job; verified against receipts then deleted before artifact upload
artifact_policy.shard_artifact: endpoint rows, terminal occupancy, annual visitor-count vectors, source/receipt hash root, and shard coverage only
artifact_policy.final_artifact: merged full-design summary plus exact coverage audit; no raw arrays

full_coverage_gate: every one of 128 frozen history seeds appears in exactly one shard
every history x demographic_seed x start x arm case appears exactly once
each shard campaign is complete before extraction
each receipt case hash and arrays SHA256 is verified before extraction
annual richness-matched near/far count vectors are identical before analysis
no result sign, mixed fraction, rank, or precision outcome controls stopping

scientific_analysis_contract.endpoint: paired far-minus-near inherited investment change, separately by intervention
scientific_analysis_contract.eligibility: trait contrasts require both arms occupied at baseline and terminal; sign histories require all starts and repeats; occupancy always unconditional
scientific_analysis_contract.mean_interval: 1999 bootstrap resamples of independent histories; same resample indices across starts and interventions; RNG 927032
scientific_analysis_contract.mixed_interval: 95% Hoeffding bound over eligible independent histories; descriptive eight-repeat labels, not latent signs
scientific_analysis_contract.demographic_stability: repeat-specific labels plus first-four versus last-four average labels; report all
scientific_analysis_contract.S_C_I: balanced descriptive initial state x paired-history effect, within-cell variance separately
scientific_analysis_contract.stopping: fixed cohorts; no significance/precision/outcome stopping; limits can produce inconclusive outcomes
scientific_analysis_contract.initial_discretization: separate founder-support sensitivity, not solver error or continuous convergence

reason: Resource-only pilot projected ~5.0 GB monolithic raw output; sharding and verified endpoint extraction preserves the frozen case set while avoiding unnecessary artifact storage.
